vulnerability_status: BLOCKED - not assessed. npm audit and bun audit both return HTTP 404 against the sandbox registry mirror and no offline advisory database is available.

lockfile_provenance.authoritative_for_ci: package-lock.json - every GitHub Actions job installs with `npm ci`, which fails if package-lock.json is absent or out of sync with package.json
lockfile_provenance.authoritative_for_platform_build: bun.lock - the hosting build installs with bun
lockfile_provenance.stale: bun.lockb - the legacy binary Bun lockfile, superseded by the text bun.lock; retained only because it was never deleted
lockfile_provenance.why_three: the project was created on a bun-based toolchain (bun.lockb), migrated to the text bun lockfile (bun.lock) when bun changed formats, then had npm-based CI workflows added which required package-lock.json. None of the three was removed.
lockfile_provenance.risk: dependency resolution is not guaranteed to be identical between CI (npm) and the hosting build (bun); an advisory fixed in one lockfile can remain unfixed in the other
